caseName: Cossett v. Merchants & Mechanics Federal Savings & Loan Ass'n
caseNameFull: Cossett et ux. v. Merchants & Mechanics Federal Savings & Loan Assn.

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 6th Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
